item.title: The role of small hydropower in achieving Sustainable Development Goals
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 26 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00843-6

The reliability and adaptability of small hydropower facilitate energy access in remote and underserved regions. This Review identifies opportunities and challenges for this technology, including environmental impacts and the increasing decarbonization of power systems, and highlights strategic interventions that optimize its sustainability and socioeconomic benefits.
